page: Microsoft Azure HB120-32rs_v3 is a high-performance virtual machine belonging to the HBv3 server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 456.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 14.25 GB per core.

For local storage, the server includes a 2412 GB NVMe SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. The instance supports Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) networking, which enables low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

Given its high memory capacity of 456.0 GB relative to its 32 dedicated vCPUs, this server offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads. The combination of dedicated compute resources, substantial NVMe storage, and RDMA capabilities makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, and high-performance computing tasks that require fast node-to-node communication without GPU acceleration.
